title: Mrs K Jackson v Direct Help and Advice 2600922/2015
text:
EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS

Claimant: 		Mrs K Jackson

Respondent: 	Direct Help and Advice

Heard at:		Nottingham			On:	Friday 6 May 2016

Before:		Employment Judge Solomons (sitting alone)
		
Representation
Claimant:			Mr M Porter, Representative 
Respondent:		Ms T Attenborough, Solicitor	


RESERVED JUDGMENT

The claim of unfair dismissal is not well founded and is dismissed.

REASONS

The parties will be provided with written reasons for this judgment in due course without the need for any request for written reasons to be made.









						_____________________________

						Employment Judge Solomons	
				
						Date

						JUDGMENT SENT TO THE PARTIES ON

						 .....................................................................................

						 ......................................................................................
						FOR THE TRIBUNAL OFFICE

Note
Reasons for the judgment having been given orally at the hearing, written reasons will not be provided unless a request was made by either party at the hearing or a written request is presented by either party within 14 days of the sending of this written record of the decision.
description: Employment Tribunal Decision of Judge Solomons on 22 June 2016
